findings: The candidate preserves the frozen global, causal-local, shuffled, replay, checkpoint, delayed-return, far-output, and natural-quiescence controls.
Deferral and replacement are implemented as distinct physical protocols with the unchanged Physical protocol remaining the default.
Software verification supports faithful execution and measurement of the campaign; it does not reverse the scientific falsification of either solve arm.
residual_uncertainty: No solve arm reached and left both one-joint limits within the frozen 40-step budget, so repeated-axis and later sensorimotor claims remain untested.
Causal-local return, deferral, and replacement remain candidate physics and have not entered organism authority.
